name: novabid
description: Post one business trip request to independent Edinburgh hotels and receive private offers. Read-only: prepares a pre-filled trip form link, never posts or books.

interface.longDescription:
NovaBid is a UK service for business travel to Edinburgh. A business posts one trip request (dates, guests, rooms, budget and needs), independent Edinburgh hotels and guest houses reply with private offers, and the business picks one and pays.

In ChatGPT, NovaBid can:
- explain how NovaBid works, for a business booking a stay or for a hotel thinking of joining;
- check whether NovaBid serves a city (Edinburgh for now);
- prepare a trip request: a short summary and a link to the NovaBid trip form with the details filled in.

Nothing is posted, booked or paid in ChatGPT. You open the link, check the details and send the request yourself on novabid.co.uk. Post your trip in two minutes.

NovaBid is run by NovaBid Ltd, registered in Scotland (SC886622).
